verdict.rationale: LangSmith's docs say it supports OpenTelemetry-based tracing, so any OTel-compatible application or agent can send traces to it, and a community reply confirms the OpenTelemetry integration. Only the ingest direction is evidenced: nothing shows LangSmith emitting or exporting traces over OTLP, and the collector fanout describes the OTel Collector routing data, not LangSmith exporting it. Missing for 10: documented OTLP export/receive of traces out of LangSmith, explicit OTLP endpoint/protocol details (HTTP/gRPC, auth headers), independent hands-on corroboration of OTLP ingest.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send and receive traces over OpenTelemetry (OTLP) instead of a proprietary format

citations.quote: LangSmith supports OpenTelemetry-based tracing, allowing you to send traces from any OpenTelemetry-compatible application.
LangSmith supports OpenTelemetry-based tracing, allowing you to send traces from any OpenTelemetry-compatible agent.
